core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hadees corresponds to the Arabic form حديث (Arabic root ح د ث (ḥ-d-th); حديث (ḥadīth)). Its core sense is narration, report, hadith (the prophet's sayings). Hadees is Arabic حديث (ḥadīth) 'a narration, report, account' — in Islamic usage the recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet. The source gloss 'guide, teacher, guide to the right path' is a loose extrapolation of that; the lexical sense is 'narration, report'.

urdu.name: حدیث
